#!/usr/bin/env bash

cat << 'DEBUGCONN' | sudo tee /usr/local/bin/debug-connection.sh
#!/bin/bash
TARGET_IP=\"$1\"
TARGET_PORT=\"${2:-9443}\"
INTERFACE=\"${3:-eth0}\"
PREFIX=\"${TARGET_IP}-${TARGET_PORT}\"

echo \"=== Debugging connection to $TARGET_IP:$TARGET_PORT ===\"

# Add iptables logging
iptables -I OUTPUT 1 -d \"$TARGET_IP\" -p tcp --dport \"$TARGET_PORT\" -j LOG --log-prefix \"OUT-$PREFIX: \" --log-level 7
iptables -I INPUT 1 -s \"$TARGET_IP\" -p tcp --sport \"$TARGET_PORT\" -j LOG --log-prefix \"IN-$PREFIX: \" --log-level 7

# Ensure not blocked
iptables -I OUTPUT 1 -d \"$TARGET_IP\" -p tcp --dport \"$TARGET_PORT\" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -I INPUT 1 -s \"$TARGET_IP\" -p tcp --sport \"$TARGET_PORT\" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true

# Check conntrack
echo \"--- Conntrack entries ---\"
conntrack -L -p tcp 2>/dev/null | grep \"$TARGET_IP\" || echo \"No entries\"

# Start tcpdump in background
tcpdump -i \"$INTERFACE\" -nn host \"$TARGET_IP\" and port \"$TARGET_PORT\" -c 10 &
TCPDUMP_PID=$!
sleep 2

# Test connection
echo \"--- Testing connection ---\"
timeout 5 bash -c \"exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$TARGET_IP/$TARGET_PORT\" 2>&1 && echo \"Connected!\" || echo \"Connection failed\"

# Cleanup
kill $TCPDUMP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -D OUTPUT -d \"$TARGET_IP\" -p tcp --dport \"$TARGET_PORT\" -j LOG 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -D INPUT -s \"$TARGET_IP\" -p tcp --sport \"$TARGET_PORT\" -j LOG 2>/dev/null || true
echo \"Debug complete\"
DEBUGCONN

sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/debug-connection.sh
echo \"Use: sudo debug-connection.sh <ip> <port> [interface]\"
